---
id: "smk-01"
title: "FC Barcelona"
---

FC Barcelona is a professional football club based in Barcelona, in the Catalonia region of Spain. Founded in 1899 by a group of Swiss, English and Catalan players led by Joan Gamper, the club plays its home matches at the Camp Nou, one of the largest stadiums in Europe. Barcelona has won the Spanish league championship many times and has also won the Copa del Rey and the European Cup, later the Champions League, on several occasions. The club is owned by its members rather than by a private investor, and its motto, 'more than a club', reflects its role in Catalan identity. Its rivalry with Real Madrid, known as El Clásico, is one of the most watched fixtures in world football. The club's youth academy, La Masia, has produced many of the players who formed the successful sides of the early twenty-first century.
